_bma_variant: p53-aberrant IHC pattern: either (a) diffuse strong nuclear staining >80% of tumor cell nuclei (overexpression, missense surrogate) OR (b) complete absence of nuclear staining with intact internal controls — endothelium/stroma must stain positive (null pattern, nonsense/frameshift surrogate). Equivocal (heterogeneous, patchy <80% or wild-type-pattern) = p53-wildtype by IHC. Note: BIO-TP53-IHC (this entry) ≠ BIO-TP53-MUTATION — IHC is the clinical surrogate used in ESMO 2023 molecular subtyping; sequencing confirmation optional but not required for guideline application.
